format: Markdown (with embedded code snippets and structured content)
description: This file documents the 'Subsystems' framework in Thunder, outlining how subsystems like Network, Graphics, Internet, etc., are represented, managed, and utilized within plugins. It explains the structure of subsystem metadata, mechanisms for marking subsystems as active/inactive, checking their status, subscription to change notifications, and their role in plugin lifecycle and dependencies.
external_methods: SubSystems() method in plugin service shell

classes.name: InternetInfo
classes.description: Implementation of the IInternet interface providing network details such as IP address and network type for the INTERNET subsystem.

methods.name: InternetInfo::PublicIPAddress
methods.description: Returns the network's public IP address, stored internally within the implementation.

methods.name: InternetInfo::NetworkType
methods.description: Returns the network type (UNKNOWN, IPV4, IPV6) for the INTERNET subsystem.

methods.name: Notification::Updated
methods.description: Callback invoked when the state of any subsystem changes, used to notify plugins of subsystem status updates.
